description: This file defines Swagger API documentation classes for the Interest Rate Chart Slabs API in the Fineract project. It includes nested classes representing request and response models for creating, updating, and deleting interest rate chart slabs, with schema annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: InterestRateChartSlabsApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains nested static classes representing request and response schemas for interest rate chart slabs API.

classes.name: PostInterestRateChartsChartIdChartSlabsRequest
classes.description: Schema for creating a new interest rate chart slab, including fields like period type, interest rate, locale, and incentives.

classes.name: PostInterestRateChartsChartIdChartSlabsIncentives
classes.description: Schema for incentives associated with interest rate slabs, including entity type, attribute, condition, value, incentive type, and amount.

classes.name: PostInterestRateChartsChartIdChartSlabsResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response when creating a slab, primarily returning the resource ID.

classes.name: PutInterestRateChartsChartIdChartSlabsChartSlabIdRequest
classes.description: Schema for updating an existing interest rate slab, mainly updating the interest rate and description.

classes.name: PutInterestRateChartsChartIdChartSlabsChartSlabIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for the update response, including resource ID and changes made.

classes.name: DeleteInterestRateChartsChartIdChartSlabsResponse
classes.description: Schema for delete response, primarily returning the resource ID.

methods.name: InterestRateChartSlabsApiResourceSwagger
methods.description: Container class with nested classes; no methods defined at top level.
